jsonld_raw.name: (350 G) POPPY FIELDS SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Poppy Fields | This fragrance is created from the fresh notes of bergamot and the spicy touch of pink pepper. The heart of the fragrance offers a magnificent scent captured by the essence of rose and ylang ylang. The rounded vanilla and the talc notes bring it a timeless sensuality.

Notes:
Top: pink berries, bergamot, violet and jasmine.
Heart notes: rose, geranium, ylang ylang, clove.
Base notes: musk, vanilla, amber.
